crossRefs.note: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

people.name: Goah
people.line: A place near Jerusalem, mentioned in a prophetic context.

translations.web: The measuring line will go out further straight onward to the hill Gareb, and will turn toward Goah.
translations.bsb: The measuring line will once again stretch out straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn toward Goah.
translations.kjv: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb, and shall compass about to Goath.
translations.asv: And the measuring line shall go out further straight onward unto the hill Gareb, and shall turn about unto Goah.
